text:
maria_sales: Quick heads upAcme Retail asked for a perf validation we can show to their infra team. Key asks: sustain 250 qps, handle 15-30s microbursts up to 700 qps, p95 <200ms for interactive completions. They want a one-pager runbook + cost delta hosted vs dedicated.
devin_se: OK. Do we have their representative prompt mix and token averages? that'll drive batching and memory.
tara_perf: They shared a sample: median prompt ~55 tokens, median response ~160 tokens; mix: 75% short chat (1-3 turns), 25% long completions. Model: community 70B quant (8-bit).
devin_se: Plan suggestion: 1) smoke warmup (5m at 30% target qps), 2) steady-state (30m at 250 qps), 3) burst matrix (3 levels: 400, 550, 700 qps, 20s each, 2m spacing), 4) cross-AZ failover test (10% traffic -> fallback region). Document step for each.
maria_sales: Theyalso worried about cold-start spikes and routing fallbacks. Include prewarm and KV-cache priming.
tara_perf: Prewarm: push 2k unique prefixes to prime KV cache and run a 10m low-concurrency run to fill GPU caches. For Dedicated recommend reserving ~10% headroom (warm standby). For Hosted recommend keeping 2 warm workers during demo.
ops_harsh: Infra sizing note: on A100-class machines with quantized 70B and our runtime, 250 sustained ~5 GPUs with optimized batching and KV cache. To tolerate 700 qps microburst safely, keep 8 GPUs or use autoscale policy with 90s cooldown. Hosted unit-cost multiplier ~1.8x.
devin_se: Measurement matrix: capture p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/s, avg batch size, GPU util, queue length, and tail-latency traces (sample 0.5%). Also capture ingress->egress network RTT for cross-AZ test.
nina_sec: Security asks from them: SAML SSO, KMS integration for encryption at rest, and audit logs retained 90d. For tests using customer PII need DPA signed + KMS access. For demo data Hosted is fine.
maria_sales: Can we give a quick monthly cost sketch for 1M requests/month (avg 215 tokens/request)? They want hosted vs. small dedicated commit.
ops_harsh: Ballpark: Hosted inference-only: ~$4.2k/mo (depends on token price and burst billing). Dedicated reserved (12-mo equivalent amortized): ~$2.7k/mo plus ops/support. We'll prepare a cleaner appendix after run.
tara_perf: Loadgen command we'll use (custom lua + wrk):
```
wrk -t12 -c350 -d20s -R700 --script=dialog_mix.lua --latency ${TARGET}
```
We'll run the steady-state with -R250 for 30m.
perf-bot: perf job #992 queued: image build ok, script attached.
devin_se: Also test with KV-cache disabled and quant=16 fallback to show cost/latency tradeoffs. We'll include both curves.
nina_sec: Reminder: before customer-run on their real corpus we need the signed DPA & SSO test account. Share the clause they need if they insist on Private.
maria_sales: Timeline requested by Acme: results by Monday EOD. Can we do internal dry-run tomorrow and customer-run Friday?
tara_perf: I can do dry-run tomorrow 08:30 PT. Need the sample corpus + API key with the same model variant.
ops_harsh: I'll spin up test cluster: 8 x A10g equiv in us-west1, ephemeral logs to secure bucket, network path instrumented. Credentials to vault.
nina_sec: Also list what we need from customer: SSO metadata, KMS PEM for key exchange (if Private), and confirmation on whether test uses real PII.
maria_sales: I'll collect SSO metadata and get DPA signature process started. Uploading corpus link now: https://redwood-internal/pocts/acmeretail/corpus-v2
tara_perf: Dry-run quick notes (posterior): steady 250 qps -> p95 ~185ms, p99 ~420ms. 700 qps microburst -> p95 spiked ~520ms, p99 ~1.1s. With KV-cache disabled steady p95 increased ~28%. GPU util avg ~78% sustained, spiking to 99% during bursts. Charts + raw CSVs in secure link.
devin_se: Good. Add a focused run for cross-AZ: route 10% traffic to region-b for 10m and capture added latency. Expect p95 increase ~40-70ms depending on inter-region RTT.
maria_sales: Action items: 1) i will confirm DPA status + upload corpus (EOD today). 2) harsh will provision cluster (done by 07:30 PT tomorrow). 3) tara runs dry-run and posts results. 4) nina prepares security checklist and required contract language.
ops_harsh: Cluster provisioned and ready for dry-run. Autoscale policy set to 60s cooldown.
perf-bot: perf job #992 completed: results uploaded to secure storage.
tara_perf: I'll assemble one-pager runbook + short slide deck (charts, config knobs to toggle, and cost appendix).
devin_se: Recommended runtime config in appendix: batch_max_wait_ms=1024, max_batch_tokens=30000, kv_cache=true, quant=8 for Dedicated.
maria_sales: I'll propose Friday 10:00 PT for customer-facing run; will push calendar when DPA status is green. Thanks team :thumbsup:
perf-bot: Note: upcoming maintenance window Sun 01:00-03:00 PT; avoid scheduling runs then.
